tokens.name: black
tokens.usage: Headings, body text, primary buttons, the announcement bar, footer and B2B band. The brand's main presence.

tokens.name: white
tokens.usage: The page ground everywhere, and the background behind every product photo. Text on black.

tokens.name: grey
tokens.usage: Secondary text on white: prices' context, descriptions, captions (5.4:1 on white).

tokens.name: soft
tokens.usage: Rare: placeholder fill and very quiet separators. Never behind products and never as a section ground.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: 1px hairlines: card frames, inputs, dividers between list rows.

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: Spot accent only: the 'New' tag fill, a word highlight, dots and rules on black. Never a button or a large surface. As text: only on black.

tokens.name: gold-deep
tokens.usage: Spot accent on white: eyebrow rule, link underline, hover underline in the nav, progress bars. Lines and icons only (3.2:1), not body text.

tokens.name: red
tokens.usage: Sale tag and alerts only, occasionally. White text on red.

tokens.name: on-black-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on black (B2B band, footer).

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between swatch dots.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between chips and inline buttons.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between product cards (column).

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Minimum side gutter on phones; card inner padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Section heading to content.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between blocks inside a section.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Section padding on phones.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Section padding on desktop.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Everything rectangular: buttons, cards, images, inputs, tags. The brand is square.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Only filter chips, the 'no minimum' pill and color swatch dots.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Card and image frames in line color.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Black rule under section headings and under the header; black frame on hover and on the selected state.
